The ''' Bilbousa saloon''' was located in the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space's]] capital [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]].

==History==
This [[Cantina/Legends|saloon]] contained an outside terrace and an inside central bar with many tables and was guarded by four [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] guards. An [[Unidentified Ithorian bartender (Nal Hutta)/Legends|Ithorian]] and a [[Ran-D housekeeper droid/Legends|Ran-D housekeeper droid]] worked at the cantina as bartenders.<ref name="Friends and Enemies" />

Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Padawan/Legends|padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] came to the cantina to seek out information regarding [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]], interrogating the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] bartender and getting in a fight with two Gamorrean guards.<ref name="Friends and Enemies" />
